description: In every PA model, the specified equality-substitution constructor retains acceptance: accepted proofs of \(s=t\) and \(B(s)\) give an accepted proof of the actual coded instance \(B(t)\), provided the terms, one-slot formula and resulting sentence pass the stated syntax tests.
